svg.text: Each at icon size, then at 32 and 16 points, where marks fall apart.
Several agents in a row; the one that
needs you is up and lit.
Three moving as one, the leader out
front. The old Formation, in colour.
One agent, one badge: something is
The current faces, made one bold
Faces again: three of them, each its
own colour, the front one yours.
You at the centre, your agents going
The letter A drawn as three joined
Sessions fanned out like cards; pick
Cells working side by side; one lit
A conversation handed from agent to
